pub assume_specification<T, E, F, O>[Result::<T, E>::or_else](
    result: Result<T, E>,
    op: O,
) -> (out: Result<T, F>)
where
    O: FnOnce(E) -> Result<T, F>,
    requires

        result is Err ==> op.ensures((result->Err_0,), out),

pub assume_specification<'a, T, F, K>[ <[T]>::is_sorted_by_key::<F, K> ](
    slice: &'a [T],
    f: F,
) -> (ret: bool)
where
    F: FnMut(&'a T) -> K,
    K: PartialOrd,
    requires
        K::obeys_partial_cmp_spec(),
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < slice@.len() ==>
            #[trigger] f.requires((&slice@[i],)),
        forall|i: int, left1: K, right1: K, left2: K, right2: K|
            #![trigger
                f.ensures((&slice@[i],), left1),
                f.ensures((&slice@[i + 1],), right1),
                f.ensures((&slice@[i],), left2),
                f.ensures((&slice@[i + 1],), right2)
            ]
            0 <= i
                && i + 1 < slice@.len()
                && f.ensures((&slice@[i],), left1)
                && f.ensures((&slice@[i + 1],), right1)
                && f.ensures((&slice@[i],), left2)
                && f.ensures((&slice@[i + 1],), right2)
                ==> (
                    (left1.partial_cmp_spec(&right1) matches Some(
                        core::cmp::Ordering::Less | core::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
                    ))
                    == (left2.partial_cmp_spec(&right2) matches Some(
                        core::cmp::Ordering::Less | core::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
                    ))
                ),
    ensures
        ret ==> (exists|keys: Seq<K>| {
            &&& keys.len() == slice@.len()
            &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < keys.len() ==>
                #[trigger] f.ensures((&slice@[i],), keys[i])
            &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i && i + 1 < keys.len() ==> (
                #[trigger] keys[i].partial_cmp_spec(&keys[i + 1]) matches Some(
                    core::cmp::Ordering::Less | core::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
                )
            )
        }),
        !ret ==> (exists|bad: int, keys: Seq<K>| {
            &&& 0 <= bad
            &&& bad + 1 < slice@.len()
            &&& keys.len() == bad + 2
            &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < keys.len() ==>
                #[trigger] f.ensures((&slice@[i],), keys[i])
            &&& forall|i: int| 0 <= i < bad ==> (
                #[trigger] keys[i].partial_cmp_spec(&keys[i + 1]) matches Some(
                    core::cmp::Ordering::Less | core::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
                )
            )
            &&& !(#[trigger] keys[bad].partial_cmp_spec(&keys[bad + 1]) matches Some(
                core::cmp::Ordering::Less | core::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
            ))
        }),
;

pub assume_specification<'a, T: Clone + Clone>[ Bound::<&'a T>::cloned ](
    bound: Bound<&'a T>,
) -> (result: Bound<T>)
    ensures
        spec_bound(bound) is Unbounded ==> spec_bound(result) is Unbounded,
        spec_bound(bound) is Included ==> spec_bound(result) is Included
            && cloned::<T>(*(spec_bound(bound)->Included_0), spec_bound(result)->Included_0),
        spec_bound(bound) is Excluded ==> spec_bound(result) is Excluded
            && cloned::<T>(*(spec_bound(bound)->Excluded_0), spec_bound(result)->Excluded_0),
;
rationale: The repeated Clone bound preserves both the impl-level and method-level bounds required by signature matching. spec_bound exposes the variant and payload, while cloned models the delegated Clone call without imposing an artificial determinism precondition.

pub assume_specification<R: core::ops::RangeBounds<usize>>[
    alloc::string::String::replace_range::<R>
](
    s: &mut alloc::string::String,
    range: R,
    replace_with: &str,
)
    requires
        slice_range_valid(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len()),
        is_char_boundary(encode_utf8(old(s)@), slice_range_start(&range)),
        is_char_boundary(encode_utf8(old(s)@), slice_range_end(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len())),
    ensures
        final(s)@ == decode_utf8(encode_utf8(old(s)@).subrange(0, slice_range_start(&range)))
            + replace_with@
            + decode_utf8(encode_utf8(old(s)@).subrange(
                slice_range_end(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len()),
                encode_utf8(old(s)@).len() as int
            )),
;
rationale: RangeBoundsSpec models the single checked range normalization, the UTF-8 boundary preconditions match the source assertions, and the postcondition gives the exact prefix, replacement, and suffix.
